resources.string: One remote for one living room.
tutti is a remote for a Sony BRAVIA TV and a BRAVIA Theatre Bar, built to replace BRAVIA Connect day to day. Setup and calibration stay in BRAVIA Connect, and tutti opens it when you need it.
tutti talks to the TV and the bar over your home network. No account needed: without Sony sign-in, which is optional, nothing leaves the living room.
tutti remembers the TV’s secure identity. A renewed HTTPS certificate with the same key keeps working; a changed key is refused until you pair again.
Pairing keys and any Sony tokens are encrypted with an Android Keystore key and left out of backups.
Every protocol detail is verified before tutti relies on it.
No state rests on colour alone: a shape, an icon or a word always says it too.
When Android’s animations are turned off, tutti keeps still.
